messages.subject: Project Cedar - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Good to be working opposite you again. Attached are draft heads of terms for Project Cedar. Key points: enterprise value £41.5m on a cash-free debt-free basis with a normalised working-capital adjustment; buy-side W&I with seller recourse limited to a nominal amount for the general warranties; exclusivity to 1 April. Grateful for your clients' comments.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0834

messages.plaintextBody:
